alt: Design directly in your codebase. Dessn turns a real codebase into a design canvas in one click.
Dessn website: turn your codebase into a design canvas in one click.

What it does: connects to your repo and builds a design canvas from your real components. How you use it: design visually, collaborate live, and prompt AI to explore layouts. Good to know: it is read-only, so nothing is pushed back to your repo.
